# Milestone 4 (NHPR)

> Source: ABDM Sandbox V3 Documentation

[Home](https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3) / [Documentation](https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3/new-documentation) / Milestone 4 (NHPR)**National Healthcare Providers Registry**

**What is Milestone M4?**

National Healthcare Providers Registry (NHPR) is a comprehensive repository of registered Healthcare Professional and Health Facility.

Healthcare professionals with different system of medicines (Modern medicine, Dentistry, Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa, Homeopathy) and Nurses practitioners delivering healthcare services across India.

Health Facilities like hospitals, clinics, diagnostic laboratories and imaging centers, pharmacies, bloodbanks, etc.

Integration of NHPR functionality in the healthcare application/software is milestone M4. Integrating with M4 functionalities will enable registration of health professionals and health facilities natively. 

After an entity successfully completed integration of ABDM milestones, M1, M2, and M3, integration for M4 can be initiated. To proceed with this integration following roles should be assigned to the client-id:

- HPID role
- HFR role
**Steps for NHPR native integration? **

Integration Workflow (Sequence for APIs Implementation) 

- Implementation of Test Cases ( [https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3/new-documentation?doc=TestCases](https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3/new-documentation?doc=TestCases) )
- Functional Testing (NHPR Team) ( write to [abdm.texp1@nha.gov.in](https://sandboxcms.abdm.gov.inmailto:abdm.texp1@nha.gov.in) ; [facility.abdm@nha.gov.in](https://sandboxcms.abdm.gov.inmailto:facility.abdm@nha.gov.in) for an internal demonstration )
- Share video recording of the implemented workflow with NHA 
- Security Certificate submission ( Security audit report along with VAPT report )
- Assignment of required roles (HFR/HPID) by NHA team
Website: [https://hspsbx.abdm.gov.in/home](https://hspsbx.abdm.gov.in/home)

Please go to the menu item, Resource Center -> API Documentation for documentation and presentation with registration steps on NHPR portal.
